name: escrcpy
description: 📱 Display and control your Android device graphically with scrcpy.
one_liner: A desktop app that shows your Android phone's screen on your computer and lets you control it with your mouse and keyboard — including controlling several phones at once.
buyer: A mobile QA lead or phone-repair shop owner who needs to view and control many Android devices from one desk — for testing apps across devices or diagnosing customer phones without picking each one up.
business_use_cases: A mobile app QA team runs regression tests across a rack of 10 Android test devices simultaneously from a single screen, using the batch screenshot and multi-device control features.
A phone repair shop remotely diagnoses and configures customer devices on the bench without physically handling each one, speeding up turnaround.
A 'device farm' rental business (renting real-device access to app developers for testing) uses this as the control layer for its device fleet.

money_ideas.idea: Rent access to a rack of real Android devices for mobile QA teams, using this tool as the remote-control layer, billed by the hour.
The project itself already sells a paid extension (EscrcpyX) for advanced automation features on top of the free core — a proven upsell model to replicate.

steal_this: Buy 5 cheap used Android phones, wire them into this tool, and offer 'remote real-device testing' to indie app developers as an hourly-rented alternative to expensive device-farm services.
